messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate detected (5xx) on inference-gateway-us-east-1. Alerting on-call. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infer-5xx

sam: saw the pager, jumping in. any obvious upstream changes?

rachel: nothing in infra deploys in the last 15m. noticed spike correlates with model-runner group A.

mike: adding logs from gateway here: 
```
[2026-03-17T02:07:21Z] 502 gateway: upstream failed: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-17T02:07:22Z] 502 model-runner-3: process exited(137) OOM
[2026-03-17T02:07:23Z] 502 model-runner-7: segfault at 0x7f.. backtrace: ...
```

ashley: @sam @rachel I'm on infer-runtime. kernels show repeated coredumps for quant-kernel. PID 4132 killed by OOM killer.

ml_ops: we pushed a quantized variant (q4_8) in canary 12:30 UTC with autoscaling rules, but traffic % increased due to rollout rule change. q4_8 has a known tighter memory headroom on long prompts.

sam: can we divert traffic off q4_8 to float32 variant until we stabilize?

rachel: yes, initiating immediate traffic policy bump: route 100% -> model-v2-fp32 in us-east-1. applying: `redwood route update --from model-v2-q4_8 --to model-v2-fp32 --region us-east-1 --instant`

mike: applying reroute now. patching healthchecks to drain nodes with >3 crashes in 5m.

incident-bot: Runbook step executed: fallback routing applied. Observability: start collecting core dumps and kmsg from affected nodes.

ashley: collecting cores: attaching snippet (sanitized): 
```
# gdb backtrace
#0 0x7f6c2a in attention_kernel+0x1a3
#1 0x7f6c7b in dispatch_forward
#2 0x55aa3c in model_infer
```

ml_ops: looks like attention kernel hit with large seq len cache growth. On long prompts KV cache balloons and with q4 memory layout, it triggers allocator fragmentation -> OOM.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) immediate: keep fallback routing, 2) medium: increase autoscaler capacity for model-runner pool + patch eviction thresholds, 3) long: revert q4_8 rollout and add prompt-length safety checks in router.

customer_ops: customers impacted: several enterprise tenants in us-east reported errors and increased latency. estimating ~3% of active sessions saw 5xx in last 10m. pinging accounts with status update.

rachel: scaling up dedicated nodes by +3 (p2-large) in us-east as buffer. `infra autoscale set model-runner-pool --min 6 --max 12` applied.

mike: nodes up. health checks show degraded but stabilizing. 502 rate dropped from 12% -> 1.4% in 5m after reroute + scale.

ashley: still seeing one box with repeated segfaults. isolating node id runner-7 and marking unhealthy. `redwood node cordon runner-7`

ml_ops: rolling back q4_8 canary entirely: `models rollback --model model-v2-q4_8 --to stable`  — executing now.

incident-bot: Action logged: fallback routing, rollback q4_8, scale up, node cordon. Incident severity -> SEV2 due to customer impact.

sam: jotted quick triage notes: probable root cause = quantization memory fragmentation + long-prompt KV-cache growth. produces intermittent OOMs & segfaults in attention kernel on q4 layout.

customer_ops: sent initial customer advisory: "We experienced elevated 5xx & timeouts in us-east affecting some inference requests. Traffic rerouted to stable variants; engineers are mitigating. We will follow up with RCA."

mike: after rollback and reroute, monitoring: error rate stabilized to baseline 0.2% over 15m. Latency normalized.

ashley: saved core dumps to secure bucket: s3://redwood-cores/3159876432/ — collected kmsg, logs, and process maps for postmortem.

ml_ops: follow-ups: add prompt-length throttling to router, add memory guardrails for q-variants, enhance canary traffic smoothing (no instantaneous jumps), add perf regression alerts for quant kernels.

sam: assigning postmortem to @rachel and @ml_ops. timeline + blameless RCA due EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation confirmed. Updating incident status to "mitigated". If reoccur, reopen with thread id 3159876432. :white_check_mark:

customer_ops: I'll send final customer update once postmortem ready. thanks team. :pray:
